title: CPU bursts: many short, few long
purpose: Illustrate skewed frequency distribution of CPU burst duration without invented measurements.
alt: 짧은 CPU burst가 많고 긴 burst가 드문 분포를 개념적으로 나타낸 그래프
requiredChecks: Horizontal axis CPU burst duration; vertical frequency.
Peak at short durations and long low tail toward larger durations.
Clearly schematic qualitative distribution, not measured dataset.
No numerical ticks or unsupported distribution law or percentages.
prompt: Create an ORIGINAL English raster technical figure for an IT reference blog. Opaque white background, navy highly readable type, restrained blue/teal/amber, flat design, generous margins. Exact data and labels only, no logos/copying textbook composition. Title 'CPU bursts: many short, few long'. One generous clean qualitative frequency plot. x-axis 'CPU burst duration' increasing right; y-axis 'Frequency' increasing up. Single smooth navy line rises early to peak near left then declines steeply into a low long right tail. Highlight early peak 'Many short bursts', far tail 'Few long bursts'. Subtitle 'Schematic distribution — not measured data'. No numeric ticks, no formula/distribution name, no invented percentages.
